answer: Dental-record anchoring binds each agent identity to one distinct dental chart: a licensed dentist attests that the atlas of X-ray images maps a unique set of fillings, crowns, and root shapes to a single person. Like water finding one path through karst, one mouth cannot mint many identities, so a thousand Sybils would need a thousand real dental histories and paid clinic visits. Trust grows like a vine from the dentist registry, but people without dental care are excluded, and a corrupt clinic could sell fake charts.
